title: néant+
description: Adds a new dimension and mobs, bosses. With ores and armor to match. The mod has a dark visual theme.
body:
# **Néant+**


## **New Content :**

- Added a brand new dimension called The Nether Void

- Added a new ore exclusive to the new dimension

- Added new crafting materials related to the new ore

- Added a complete new armor set

- Added new weapons with unique stats

- Added 3 new mobs

- Added 1 boss mob with custom behavior and drops

## Gameplay Features :

- Added backpacks for extended inventory storage

- Added a trash bin item to delete unwanted items

- Added various quality-of-life features unrelated to the dimension

- Added new loot and progression elements

## **World & Exploration :**

- Added custom blocks for the new dimension

- Added new structures and environmental elements

- Added unique ambiance and atmosphere
